🪿 Goose v1.30.0 Release Notes
Released: April 8, 2026
✨ New Features
🖥️ Terminal UI (TUI) Overhaul
Tab-expandable tool calls — tool call output now collapses cleanly with tab to expand
Improved message rendering — better ordering, streaming/scrolling, and overall visual polish for messages, tool calls, and text entry (#8144, #8156, #8214)
Independent --text mode — text mode is now decoupled from the normal TUI for a cleaner headless experience
goose serve — new subcommand to run Goose as a background service
🔌 Providers & Models
Gemini OAuth provider — first-class OAuth-based authentication for Google Gemini
Copilot ACP provider — new provider for GitHub Copilot via ACP
Zhipu declarative provider — adds Zhipu AI with configurable ZHIPU_BASE_URL override
Configurable fast_model for declarative providers — lets you specify a lightweight model for quick tasks
Gemma 4 local model support — enable Gemma 4 as a local model option
VMware Tanzu Platform provider improvements — bug fixes, streaming support, and UI enhancements
🛡️ Security & Observability
Egress logging inspector — new security feature to log and inspect outbound network calls
Restricted secrets file permissions — secrets files are now created with tighter OS-level permissions
🧩 Extensions & Skills
Show installed skills in UI — skills are now visible and browsable from the desktop app
Skills platform extension — skills are now managed as a dedicated platform extension
Recursively discover nested skills — skills under configured roots are now found at any depth
Configurable extension timeouts — set timeouts per-extension via ACP _meta or a global default
Reusable ACP provider controls — shared UI components for ACP provider configuration
Rust ACP client for extension methods
Developer MCP server enhancements
🌐 Internationalization
i18n infrastructure — added react-intl based internationalization framework to the desktop app
🩺 Diagnostics
goose doctor — new command to diagnose common configuration and environment issues
⚙️ Configuration
GOOSE_SHOW_FULL_OUTPUT — new config option to disable tool output truncation
GOOSE_CLI_SHOW_THINKING — can now be set in config.yaml (not just env vars)
GOOSE_CONTEXT_LIMIT — now readable from config.yaml
GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING — now honoured from config.yaml at startup
Per-delegate max_turns override
skip_canonical_filtering for declarative providers
🏗️ Build & Packaging

Fixed a critical deadlock in MCP elicitation that caused requests to timeout immediately when an MCP server called elicitInput().
The Problem:
When an MCP server triggered elicitation, the form would appear in the UI but immediately timeout due to a deadlock in the agent's tool execution loop.

Rust (agent.rs): Changed the tool execution loop to use tokio::select! with a 100ms timeout, allowing the loop to periodically check for elicitation messages even when tools are blocked

Countdown timer showing time remaining (5 minutes)
